checks.name: Native booking selection
checks.detail: Booking selection uses a compact real dropdown, preserves change handling and fits the mobile viewport.

checks.name: Shared workflow boundary
checks.detail: All 14 handlers are discoverable and no fictional browser cases were imported into server storage.

checks.name: Shared case review and persistence
checks.detail: Office evidence was prepared, explicitly approved and completed as an application review; the same case remained after reload.

checks.name: Native handoff and honest verification
checks.detail: Missing write adapters retained a checked human handoff. Manual verification was recorded as staff-manual, without any ShiftCare request.

checks.name: Stale submission
checks.detail: A stale case revision was rejected by the backend.

checks.name: Original evidence import
checks.detail: Uploaded and extracted original text is retained in private server storage and appears with its source download in the existing case.

checks.name: Verified service access boundary
checks.detail: The live service route requires independently configured identities and grants no access from a demo persona or office session.

checks.name: Authenticated shared queue
checks.detail: After logout, server cases were unavailable and the screen required office sign-in.

mapbox: External calls blocked deliberately; fallback, privacy and ETA state verified.
productionLimit: No real mailbox/OCR, ShiftCare writes, background jobs, payroll release, secure worker/client identities or device GPS certified.
